preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The lengths of strings A and B must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of favorite strings N must be between 1 and 10000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(S[i]) <= 26 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each favorite string S[i] must have a length between 1 and 26.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b[i] <= 100000 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each beauty value b[i] must be between 1 and 100000.
All favorite strings S[i] must contain only lowercase English letters.
All favorite strings S[i] must be pairwise distinct.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum pleasure Chef can get from a string he buys in the shop.
